description: Run a new Docker container in detached mode from an image.

command.description: Command to run inside the container, executed via the container's sh -c.

env.description: Environment variables to set in the container, each in KEY=VALUE form, passed to docker run -e.

image.description: Image to run the new container from, such as a name with an optional tag.

name.description: Name to assign to the new container.

ports.description: Port mappings to publish, each in host:container form, passed to docker run -p.

name: run_container
